summary: Performance audit (pagination + indexes + non-blocking + cached images) verified for Home and Browse Deals. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (1 skipped due to <2 browse-deal items in DB). /restaurants and /browse-deals both accept limit/offset correctly (offset=0 vs offset=1 return different vendors; sort preserved; slicing matches full-list). All required MongoDB indexes exist on vendors(status), vendors(status,category), menu_items(vendor_id,available_today), menu_items(vendor_id,in_stock), menu_items(food_type), orders(vendor_id,status), orders(user_id,status). Backward compat: /restaurants and /browse-deals without limit still return full list. Frontend: on load, Home issues GET /api/restaurants?lat&lon&limit=12&offset=0 (paginated first page), and /api/drops + /api/featured-deals are fired separately (non-blocking) — the restaurant list renders even if those two are still in flight. Browse Deals issues GET /api/browse-deals?lat&lon&sort_by=discount&limit=15&offset=0. Images use expo-image via CachedImage (blurred placeholder + memory-disk cache). No red screens; no regressions observed (Home cards show category / km / Open-Closed; tap navigates; sort + price chips + veg toggle still render on Browse Deals; /surplus renders price chips). Infinite scroll onEndReached is wired correctly in code but could not be exercised end-to-end because DB has only 2 active vendors (< PAGE_SIZE=12) and 0 browse-deals items — hasMore correctly stays false, no unnecessary loadMore fires. This limit is explicitly acknowledged in the review request.
action_items: OPTIONAL (only to visually verify infinite scroll): seed >12 ACTIVE vendors so Home onEndReached/loadMore + footer spinner can be observed in-app. Currently only 2 active vendors exist, so hasMore correctly stays false after the first page. API-level pagination is fully validated.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend /restaurants (server.py:871-927) applies limit/offset correctly AFTER the distance/area sort, so page 1 = truly nearest. `if limit is None: return out[offset:]` preserves backward compatibility.
Backend /browse-deals (server.py:1059-1126) applies limit/offset AFTER sort. Same backward-compat pattern. OK.

Home loadData (home.tsx:97-119) awaits ONLY the restaurants first-page fetch to gate the initial spinner, then fires dropsApi.list and featuredDeals in fire-and-forget promises — matches the 'non-blocking background loading' requirement.
Home loadMoreRestaurants (home.tsx:121-138) is guarded by loadingMore / rHasMore / loading and wired to FlatList onEndReached with threshold 0.5 and a ListFooterComponent — correct pattern.
browse-deals.tsx uses PAGE_SIZE=15, hasMore = list.length === PAGE_SIZE, onEndReached wired at threshold 0.5. Sort chip changes reset offset and refetch first page — correct.

CachedImage.tsx wraps expo-image with cachePolicy='memory-disk', blurhash placeholder, transition=200, recyclingKey=uri — meets the 'progressive + cached + no full-res in list' requirement. expo-image downsamples to display size by default.
No 'expo-av' / 'expo-barcode-scanner' / 'expo-background-fetch' deprecated imports found in files_of_reference. No SafeAreaView regressions detected.

restaurantsApi.list / browseDeals in client.ts correctly propagate limit and offset in URLSearchParams (skipping undefined) — matches observed network calls in browser (?lat=..&lon=..&limit=12&offset=0 / limit=15&offset=0).
